As someone who has used Ashby pretty regularly over the last several years... It's a product that feels like it's designed and built by the C or D team... almost literally no self service paths exist in the app for account upgrades, adding on SAML etc... you have to email them—last I checked it's a mailto: link, not even a form.

Ashby Co-founder & VPE: 'We focused on building something flexible and customizable first, with usability being something we wanted to make excellent second... Still more work to do, but thanks for putting up with some of our deficiencies :)'
I mainly used Lever before and it was more or less OK, just like Ashby is OK... I just don't see it 'so much better' to justify a switch from Lever from my point of view.
My company recently switched to it and as an EM I feel... disappointed? What's so special about it to have yet another hiring system with VC money?
I last applied for jobs in 2022 and never saw it. This year it's the majority of the jobs using it. I don't know where they came from but they seem to be eating everyone's lunch.
